title: Which container is failing?
summary: Identify application, sidecar, or init container first.
why: Logs from the wrong container can mislead.

commands.purpose: Inspect current/last state, events and probes.

title: What does termination evidence show?
summary: Use current logs, previous logs, reason, code and signal.
why: The previous instance often has the useful failure.

commands.purpose: Read current logs; redact secrets before sharing.

choices.label: Command, config, permission or dependency error

title: Init container failure
summary: Inspect the init container before the main workload.
why: The main process may never start.

commands.purpose: Read logs from the current init-container instance.
Read logs from the previous terminated init-container instance when restart history exists.

title: Memory termination confirmed
summary: Distinguish legitimate need from leak or configuration before raising limits.
why: Blind increases may hide defects or violate capacity policy.

title: Probe or startup behavior needs review
summary: Compare path, port, timing and real startup behavior.
why: Removing probes can expose unhealthy workloads.

choices.label: A specific probe or app fix exists

title: Application/runtime failure identified
summary: Correct the owning source rather than deleting Pods or changing restart policy.
why: Restarts do not repair the underlying cause.

title: Lifecycle may be mismatched
summary: A one-shot process may need a Job rather than a long-running controller.
why: Exit code 0 is not automatically a defect.

title: Apply one source-controlled correction
summary: Change only the proven image, command, config, probe, resource or workload type.
why: Scoped changes are easier to roll back and verify.
prerequisites: Confirm owning manifest and service impact.
rollback: Roll back the workload revision or prior configuration.

title: Verify stable recovery
summary: Confirm the original symptom is resolved and remains stable.

title: Crash loop resolved
summary: Recovery is verified; record cause and prevention work.

title: Escalate with redacted evidence
summary: Share Pod status, events, current/previous logs, termination state, manifest and recent changes.
